unresolved_candidate.reason: The 2018 paper distinguishes EGC from South Indian Counter Current. That alone does not establish whether EGC overlaps the existing South Indian Current (SIC) identity, whose Grand2015 source lists SIC and SICC separately. Direct source-scope comparison remains necessary.

non_inference_rules: Publication dates are not observation dates; geographic descriptions are not measured endpoints or footprints.
Qualitative reversal or seasonal orientation does not create monthly samples, annual envelopes or animation eligibility.
Current connectivity, shared water and shared monsoon forcing do not by themselves establish aliases or parent relations.
No author, publisher, source model or review article is claimed to have externally approved OSW taxonomy.
Canonical admissions must preserve historical IDs and existing measurements, then pass the shared query/native/WASM and accessible atlas gates.
